main.title: Linearizability: A Correctness Condition for Concurrent Objects
main.why: To define correctness for concurrent objects, linearizability requires each operation to appear to take effect instantly between its call and return.

main.title: Chain Replication for Supporting High Throughput and Availability
main.why: For strong consistency with high throughput, chain replication sends writes in at the head and serves reads from the tail.

main.why: Caching Facebook's reads in memcached brought stale sets and thundering herds, which leases and invalidations fix.

main.title: The Tail at Scale
main.why: With wide fan-out a few slow servers delay most requests, so services hedge requests and tolerate the tail.

main.why: Retries at every layer multiply load, so use backoff with jitter and a retry budget.
